mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output that suppresses corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during recessions when INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% reflects persistent labor market weakness that depresses consumer spending and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals aggressive monetary easing that stimulates corporate investment and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates a policy response to inflationary pressures that boosts market confidence in economic management, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal improving consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during early-cycle expansions when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
